config.preprocessing: Strip outer whitespace only; retain generated content; omit metadata, system prompts, injected profiles and transcript history. No summaries, translation or message concatenation.
config.round_rule: Round t starts with generated simulator message t, including generated initial inspection requests in review workflows. The next visible actor handoff/question/final specification before the next simulator message is its response. The fixed SciConv input question and pre-first-simulator-reply actor question are excluded. Terminal simulator messages without actor replies remain simulator observations only.
config.availability_rule: Trial 1 only for all five settings; original coordinator-finished traces. Include a round only when a nonempty role message exists under all five settings. Use this common T_q for all ten persona pairs within each question and role. No truncation to 3–4 rounds, padding, imputation or carry-forward.
config.weighting: Equal eligible rounds within each question; equal questions within each super-family; equal 25% weights for life, physical_engineering, math_cs and social_humanities. Whole-question bootstrap within source benchmark × super-family, retaining all settings and messages together.
config.case_rule: Two examples manually selected by the user after inspecting the length-enriched UMAP gallery: bix-57-q1 and matToolUse/disambiguation/case_236. These are illustrative, not representative or independent aggregate evidence. All five settings are retained with their actual lengths, including one-round trajectories.

config.projection: Local cosine UMAP jointly fit across all five settings and observed trial-1 messages, separately per question and role. n_neighbors=min(15,N−1), min_dist=0.1, 500 epochs, spectral init, random_state=42, transform_seed=42, n_jobs=1. Frozen coordinates copied exactly from the reviewed gallery; model and software provenance in umap.json and the gallery manifest. Local distances and path lengths are not effect sizes.
